title: fix(cli): scaffold `objectui generate page` with a `children` child list
body:
Fixes #9847

Clause-②: no

`objectui generate page NAME` scaffolded a `pages/NAME.json` whose child list was spelled
`body` — the dialect objectui#6771 retires. It is the **seventh** producer of that dialect,
and the one objectui#7181's six-file table never named. One key moves; four files change.

## The reading this card was really for

The card asked whether `generatePage` was the **last** producer, and whether the census
block could therefore be re-pointed at *nothing* — the day objectui#6771 step 4 becomes
landable. Measured, on `5365b4c34`, both readings taken with `pnpm census:body-dialect`
over the same tree at 2026-09-18T11:10Z (before) and 2026-09-18T11:13Z (after):

| reading | files scanned | candidate nodes | nodes carrying `body` | of those, bucket `app-metadata` |
|:--|--:|--:|--:|--:|
| before | 7771 | 1206 | 160 | **1** |
| after  | 7771 | 1206 | 159 | **0** |

The single `app-metadata` node was `generatePage`'s, and the differential is one node wide:
it is the only hit whose `body` flag changed, and it did not disappear — the same file and
node now reads `children: true`. The other 159 sit in `docs-teaching` (60), `example-app`
(61) and `test` (38), which is ruling step 5's corpus, not step 4's producers.

## ⚠️ That zero does NOT clear step 4, and this is the finding

The census states its own limits and **two of them hide a producer**: it scores a child
list only on an object that also carries a string-LITERAL `type`, and it never reads inside
a string or a template literal. A second instrument — a child-list-shaped `body` sweep over
shipped source, with a `children` control firing in the same command — resolves two sites
that are producer-shaped and that the census cannot reach. Both are live on `5365b4c34`:

- **`packages/vscode-extension/src/providers/CompletionProvider.ts`** — offers a completion
  item named `body` in its common-property list and in `card`'s, and accepting it inserts
  `"body": {…}` **into the user's own document**. This is the most direct form a producer
  takes: the author does not even type the spelling. Invisible to the census because the
  snippet is a string literal.
- **`packages/components/src/renderers/layout/tabs.tsx`** — its shipped `defaultProps`
  spells three tab panels' child lists `body`, the same `defaultProps` construct as the
  three registrations objectui#7181 moved. The renderer's canonical key is `item.content`,
  and `body` is a cast-through fallback beside it. Invisible to the census because a tab
  ITEM carries `label`/`value`/`body` and no `type`.

⛔ Neither is migrated here — the first is inside this card's stated out-of-scope fence, the
second is a fourth `defaultProps` site whose membership in objectui#6771's ruled family is
not this branch's to decide. Both are now **asserted** by the census block, so whoever moves
them is handed the re-point.

⇒ the block's claim — *the platform ships the dialect it is being asked to refuse* — is
still **TRUE**, with a third subject. It was NOT inverted into a tautology asserting this
branch's own diff back at itself, and it was NOT deleted.

## What changed

- `packages/cli/src/commands/generate.ts` — `body:` becomes `children:` in `generatePage`.
  Nothing else in the scaffolded file moves. I read the whole file: `generateResource`
  emits object metadata with no child list, and `generatePlugin` emits TypeScript, so
  neither carries the dialect. The card recorded `generatePlugin` as unread; it is read now.
- `packages/cli/src/__tests__/generate-page-dialect-9847.test.ts` — **new, from zero.** It
  RUNS the generator into a throwaway directory and reads the bytes back, rather than
  asserting over this repo's source text, because a source-text assertion over a file that
  documents the construct it asserts on passes off the comment. Its type population is
  discovered from the line `generate` prints for an unknown type, so a type added later is
  covered without anyone extending the pin — with the limit stated in its header, that a
  switch branch the printed line does not advertise is outside the sweep by construction.
- `scripts/__tests__/body-dialect-census.test.ts` — the producer block re-pointed. It keeps
  its named-producer drift guard (now seven) and gains a **population** assertion taken from
  `census()` itself: no `body`-carrying node in the `app-metadata` bucket. A producer
  arriving in a file nobody listed reds that without anyone extending a list.
- one changeset, `@object-ui/cli: minor`.

## Every assertion added or changed was shown able to FAIL

Each ablation mutated one anchor, proved the write landed on disk by blob hash, ran, then
restored with `git checkout HEAD -- PATH` and proved the restore by blob hash equality plus
an empty `git diff HEAD`. Restores ran from a `trap … EXIT INT TERM` on absolute paths.

| # | ablation | expected | observed |
|--:|:--|:--|:--|
| 1 | `generate.ts` back to `body:` | new pin reds; block's drift guard reds | 3 failed / 21 passed — both test files red |
| 2 | plant a `body` page node in `commands/add.ts`, a file the block's list does NOT name | ONLY the population assertion reds | 1 failed / 21 passed — `expected [ Array(1) ] to deeply equal []` |
| 3 | drop the `body` snippet from `CompletionProvider` | that half reds, its lit control holds | 1 failed / 21 passed |
| 4 | move the `tabs` defaultProps off `body` | that half reds, its lit control holds | 1 failed / 21 passed |
| 5 | `generate` stops printing its type list | the sweep REFUSES rather than sweeping an empty population | 1 failed / 1 passed — the refusal message, not a silent zero |

Ablation 2 matters on its own: ablation 1 fails at the drift guard and never reaches the
population assertion, so without 2 that assertion would be unproven.

## Verification

- `pnpm exec vitest run packages/cli/ scripts/` — **192 files passed, 2 skipped; 5424 tests
  passed, 2 skipped**, under the shared verify lock (`VERDICT command-exit 0`). Those two
  trees are the whole affected surface: a grep for every test anywhere naming
  `commands/generate` returns exactly one file, the census pins, with the control lit (six
  files name `commands/init` in the same command).
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/cli run type-check` — exit 0. The new pin is really in that
  program (confirmed with `--listFiles`), not excluded from it. It needed
  `pnpm --filter '@object-ui/cli^...' build` first: a fresh worktree has no built
  `@object-ui/types`, and the failures before that build were all unresolved
  `@object-ui/types/zod`, none of them mine.
- `eslint` on the three changed source files — exit 0.
- Gates, each exit 0: changeset presence, changeset no-major, changeset claims, pending
  changeset literals, control bytes, new cross-file line citations, test path roots,
  comment-mask corpus (report-only, within its held-open residue), governed-surface guard
  (NOT GOVERNED — 4 paths, none matched).

## Acceptance notes

Observations, ⛔ not filed and ⛔ not fixed here:

- `generate`'s switch accepts `object` as an alias for `resource`, but the line it prints
  for an unknown type advertises only `resource, page, plugin`. The new pin derives its
  population from the printed line, so the alias is outside its sweep by construction —
  stated in the pin's header rather than papered over. Carrier: the next card that touches
  `commands/generate.ts`.
- `packages/vscode-extension/src/providers/HoverProvider.ts` teaches `body` in its hover
  documentation for `body`, `div` and `card`. That is teaching, ruling step 5's territory
  and outside this card's fence, so it is recorded here and ⛔ not asserted by the census
  block, which asserts only on things that WRITE the spelling.
- `content/docs/utilities/cli.mdx`'s "Schema file format" section teaches a `body`-spelled
  tree. Same class: step 5's corpus. It documents the file format, ⛔ not `generate page`'s
  output, so this change owes it no edit — the docs nowhere show the scaffolded page's JSON.
